Consequently, almost all geometric and functional checkpoints failed (is_present: false). The Router was not too lenient; in fact, it accurately flagged that the object lacks the required 'single lens', 'handle/stand', and 'magnifying' properties. This is a moderate structural artifact common in AI-generated wireframes. The severity of 2.5 is appropriate—it is noticeable but does not destroy the object's recognizability as glasses.
